PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2008-09-19 | 34 m MD | Dhekiajuli | wellbore_instability | medium | 8.7 hrs NPT
Cause: Wellbore washout suspected in Dhekiajuli, oversized cuttings at surface.
Remedy: Adjusted mud rheology, ran wiper trips before continuing.

2008-09-22 | 1260 m MD | Girujan | torque_spike | high | 11.1 hrs NPT
Cause: Sharp torque increase on contact with Girujan, ROP dropped to near zero.
Remedy: Reduced WOB and RPM, reamed interval, resumed drilling at reduced parameters.

2008-09-22 | 1320 m MD | Tipam | cementing_issue | medium | 2.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Excessive cement losses to formation while cementing across Tipam.
Remedy: Staged cement job with lightweight lead slurry and full tail string.

2008-09-22 | 1616 m MD | Tipam | gas_show | medium | 4.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Background gas rise while drilling Tipam, connection gas trending up.
Remedy: Increased mud weight slightly, monitored trend, continued drilling.

2008-09-22 | 1620 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | high | 10.1 hrs NPT
Cause: Losses seen while running casing through Tipam, static losses continuing on connections.
Remedy: Spotted 30 bbl high-fluid-loss pill across the loss zone and monitored pit levels.
